scope: Local synthetic data; no Production URL or credentials; BEGIN/ROLLBACK, SAVEPOINT per scenario

results.objective: Exact baseline: 29 functions, 23 tables, 86 policies, 21 triggers and 155 constraints
Atomic preflight rejects an unexpected backup grant without partial ACL changes
Atomic preflight rejects a changed trigger function body
Atomic preflight rejects a disabled live dispatch trigger
Exact postflight: only the expected five function ACLs and 52 table grants change
Every worker/internal RPC rejects anon before execution (27 signatures)
Every worker/internal RPC rejects authenticated, including the backup (27 signatures)
All service_role and postgres EXECUTE/table privileges remain exactly equal
Existing service_request trigger fires from a real authenticated INSERT after EXECUTE/TRIGGER revoke
Existing guest INSERT also fires V2 dispatch without an EXECUTE grant
Canonical V1 service dispatch creates one mission and one outbox entry; repeated call is idempotent
Canonical V2 explicit service dispatch retains its candidate chain and idempotency
Old backup remains usable by privileged service and still can write a mission (LOCAL ONLY)
Service worker_peek retains its contact result and changes no data
Existing mission trigger fires from an authenticated column-granted INSERT
Column-level mission INSERT and UPDATE(status) remain functional and bounded
get_my_dispatch_offers_v1 is still authenticated and filters by canonical artisan owner
accept_my_dispatch_offer_v1 remains authenticated and performs the real winner transition
A second artisan cannot accept a cancelled opportunity
anon cannot call the two retained authenticated RPCs
P0 canonical Admin authority, hardened profile role and users INSERT remain intact
Protected deployed worker handler still calls peek with service_role (local fetch double)
All 52 excess table privileges are false; TRUNCATE is denied before touching data
Every CRUD grant and every column ACL is exactly preserved, including invitation token exclusion
Enterprise membership stays independent of global role; existing Enterprise RLS is retained
Existing notification frontend INSERT/UPDATE survives unchanged
Rollback is blocked by default and restores no privilege
Explicit LOCAL rollback reference restores the exact ACL baseline without changing data
Reapplying the patch is stopped by its exact-baseline preflight
The unused auto-dispatch function stays unattached; attached triggers and all function bodies are unchanged
Postflight sees no persistent test data and unchanged business constraints/RLS

limitations: No real PostgREST HTTP/JWT/connection pool, external worker or provider call
Unrelated diagnostic return type is a local stand-in; priced-offer/diagnostic branches not executed
All 134 function bodies and dispatch ACLs match the catalogue; non-dispatch helper ACLs not completely modelled
Local postgres is a PGlite owner/superuser; Production postgres is owner with BYPASSRLS
Initial S21 expected the wrong SQLSTATE; aligned to the exact Production trigger 42501, then all scenarios rerun
